Bid Summary.value: Dallas ISD is issuing bid JA-207652 for Student and Staff Computing Devices, including student Chromebooks, Windows laptops, display monitors, AIO computers, and tablets. Proposals may be submitted via an electronic portal (Oracle RFP input tool) or through manual responses using the PDF version of the solicitation and response attachments. Key requirements include white glove installation and delivery services such as asset decaling, reporting, etching, and specific software installations, along with required warranties and product specifications. Additional documentation required includes Form 1295 Certificate of Interested Parties and addendum acknowledgements. Dallas ISD anticipates requesting quotes for different projects from awarded vendors starting in September of 2024.
